exact_statement: For every uniform Boolean OR of gates each combining at most M regular functions, the disjoint least-pivotal-gate derivative partition defines normalized laws nu_j and rho_j. For every kappa_j>=1, epsilon_j=sum_T(nu_j(T)-kappa_j*rho_j(T))_+, E_nu_j G_j <= E0+(24/5)log2(M*kappa_j)+epsilon_j*Gmax_j, where E0=(24/5)[log2(sqrt(2e)+2^(3/5))+log2 e]. For the source-component forest with global root odds lambda*pi_l, 0<lambda<=1, the explicit congestion Gamma in REPORT equation (2) yields H(f)<=[K0+E0+(29/5)log2 M+Gamma]I(f), with every root/label/subset/normalization cost retained. Addressing on a selectors has read 2^a, kappa_j<=2, epsilon_j=0, Gamma<3/4+24/5 and H<=50I for all integers a>=1; this is a known class calibration. For the projective-plane line union over any prime q with delta_q=(q^2+q)2^(-q)<1, worst-event derivative congestion is at least (q+1)(1-delta_q)^2, hence is unbounded. Least-gate masses lie between 2^(-q)(1-delta_q) and 2^(-q). More generally, ideal pieces with disjoint Fourier supports outside E certify epsilon_j(4)<=nu_j(E)+(4*sum_l||a_l-d_jl||_2^2+2*||sum_l(a_l-d_jl)||_2^2)/alpha_j. On PP_q this gives epsilon_j(4)*Gmax_j<=308/5 for every prime q, and sum_j alpha_j E_nu_j G_j<93 I(PP_q). The complete PP root/label/subset payment and universal FEI remain open. For every pairwise-disjoint positive width-w clause union, w>=2,m>=1, put p=2^-w,c=(1-p)^(m-1). All distant-blocker conditioned derivative remainders and local pressures vanish, but the off-clause spectral degree mass is I(f)*(1-c). The normalized derivative entropy is w-1+(m-1)*h_g, h_g=h2(p)+p*log2(2^w-1), and diverges at fixed w. With a=(1-p)^m, the exact whole-function entropy is h2(4*a*(1-a))+4*a*(m*h_g-h2(a)); this is a known disjoint-product calibration. Hence conditioned-error-only off-support transfer is false and is not a FEI disproof. For any finite disjoint private cubes Y,Z and Boolean indicators h1<=h0,k1<=k0, f=1-2 h_x k_x has the exact terminal-inclusive influence and signed entropy ledger in DERIVATION equations (1)-(5). With a_i=E h_i,b_i=E k_i,A_i=a_i*b_i,s=(A0+A1)/2, lambda_i=A_i/(2s), normalized component references Q_hi,Q_ki positive on their blocker spectra give R=sum_i lambda_i Q_hi Q_ki, Q_C(T,xi)=R(T)/2 and, for 0<s<1, Q_f(empty)=1-v,Q_f(A)=v Q_C(A)/(1-q_e) for nonempty A, where v=4s(1-s),q_e=Q_C(empty). These are normalized whole-set references with complete CE(f,Q_f)=h2(v)+4s[CE(P_C,Q_C)-s log2(1/q_e)+(1-s)log2(1-q_e)]. The exact excess is v KL(P_C conditioned nonempty || Q_C conditioned nonempty). Zero branch masses are omitted and constant outputs use an empty point mass. No universal influence bound on this excess is claimed. In the one-shared-bit nested blocker interface, using exact normalized component spectra as terminal references, the full normalized product reference obeys 0<=CE(f,Q_prod)-H(f)<=2I(f) in every private dimension, with constants handled by the empty point mass. This retains H(f) and every terminal/gate cost and is not an FEI bound. For any fixed nonempty output subprobability M positive on actual spectrum, Z=sum M in (0,1], Q_occ(empty)=1-v and Q_occ(A)=v*M(A)/Z are normalized; complete CE=h2(v)+sum_nonempty p_f log2(1/M)+v log2 Z. The induced blocker law has empty mass s and nonempty mass (1-s)*M/Z, matching the same output activation exactly. A fixed half-half nonempty prior mixture pays at most v<=I for reference choice. For all 521 connected labelled graphs with a cut vertex on n=3,4,5 at lambda_e=1/Delta and corrected complete occupation factors, normalized occupation CE<7I/2 and product/mixture CE<3I; product beats occupation separately on all 521, but their fixed half-half mixture strictly improves product CE on 132 certified graphs. Universal occupation expectation and inherited component reference debts remain unpaid. ADDITION AT VERSION 5: For every indicator C(x,y) on any finite uniform cube, s=E C in (0,1), f=1-2C, v=4s(1-s), write c_b(T) for its two normalized Fourier rows. The law R(T,xi)=(c_0(T)^2+c_1(T)^2)/(4s) is normalized, r=R(empty) lies in [s/2,1/2], and the true blocker spectrum is at most 2R. Let P be the output spectrum conditioned nonempty, Rstar=R conditioned nonempty, and L=2(1-r)/(1-s)>1. For every fixed probability q positive on support(Rstar), S=(L Rstar-P)/(L-1) is a probability and D(P||q)=L D(Rstar||q)-(L-1)D(S||q)+L JS_(1/L)(P,S). For Q(empty)=1-v and Q(A)=v q(A) otherwise, 0<=CE(f,Q)-H(f)<=8s(1-r)D(Rstar||q)+(3+log2(e))I(f)<8s(1-r)D(Rstar||q)+(9/2)I(f). No disjointness, nesting, separator or maximum-read bound is needed. Constants use the empty point mass. If q=M/Z is an occupation reference, the full +v log2 Z term remains. For the triangle independent-set blocker queried at any vertex, s=1/2, r=5/16, L=11/4, I=3/2, P has four atoms 1/4 and Rstar has atom 5/11 at the queried singleton and six atoms 1/11. For any c<11/4 and finite K, positive fixed references q exist with D(P||q)>c D(Rstar||q)+K I. This refutes coefficient-one arbitrary-reference transport, not occupation-specific transport or FEI. The frozen lambda=1/Delta occupation law on all 249 labelled connected cut-free graphs on 3,4,5 vertices satisfies the displayed transport bound for all 1233 queried vertices by exact rational interval checks. Inherited row KL and complete terminal costs remain unpaid universally.
